documented_behavior: java.lang.Long.parseLong(String) parses a signed decimal long; its behavior is equivalent to parseLong(s, 10).
The input may have a leading '+' or '-', but otherwise must contain decimal digits and the represented value must fit in the signed long range.
Long.parseLong(String) throws NumberFormatException when the String is not parsable as a long.
